At p57-q5-g: Before part g, model: 'Let u = cos θ. Then 2u² − u = u(2u − 1) = 0, so cos θ = 0 or cos θ = 1/2. Solve both and combine: θ = 60°, 90°, 270°, 300°. Dividing by cos θ would lose the zero branch.' Before part j, add: 'sin² θ = 1 gives sin θ = 1 or sin θ = −1, hence θ = 90° or 270°.'
